<a id="a-code-formed-between-formations--在形成之间形成的编码"></a>
# A code formed between formations

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`a-code-formed-between-formations` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](a-code-formed-between-formations.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Codes changed only by hearing keep agreement exactly through closed hearings; the start and the order fix the form reached; reading across holds where codes agree; no law privileging neither form nor formation settles a symmetric disagreement; imposed and written-back codes stay.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Hearing is a process of the spine, a stretch of its run an order of hearings, and every start and sequence of hearings has its run; hearing makes no form, and a step changes a form exactly at its hearer, at the sense heard, where the rule takes the form and the speaker's form differs. (`Becoming.SharedCodes.process`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.step_at`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.window_runBy`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.state_hearings`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.hearingRun`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_held`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_changes_iff`)
2. A group agreeing at a sense keeps agreeing through every hearing closed for it, exactly unless a member hears the sense, the rule takes the form and the speaker's form is not the group's; along runs so closed no member's form changes, and agreement of all is a rest under every rule. (`Becoming.SharedCodes.agreement_kept`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.kept_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_kept_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_kept`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_agreement_kept`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.pair_kept`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.all_agree_rest`)
3. Under hearings that take the form heard, each formation holds the start's form of its origin; where two forms differ, every run with given hearings agrees from every start exactly where they give all formations one origin; the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use. (`Becoming.SharedCodes.run_origin`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_origin_window`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.agrees_every_start_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_agrees_every_start_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.shared_iff_in_use`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_shared_iff_in_use`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.TwoFormations.order_decides`)
4. Under a pointer law every start agrees at a step exactly where the pointer's paths have met; being joined through couplings is not enough: on the path a – c – b with each following the least-indexed of itself and its couplings, a and b never agree. (`Becoming.SharedCodes.follow`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.follow_state`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.follow_agrees_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.Path.never_agree`)
5. A formation whose code tells senses apart reads another's form for a sense as that sense, and only it, exactly where their codes agree there, and otherwise as another sense; a hearing keeps the hearer telling senses apart exactly where the form taken is not one it gives another sense, so agreement sense by sense can merge senses. (`Becoming.SharedCodes.self_reads_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.reads_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.reads_other`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_reads_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_reads_kept`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.keeps_apart_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_keeps_apart_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.TwoFormations.homonym`)
6. No form is privileged: runs through one order from starts differing by a renaming differ by it at every step, tell apart the same senses, and a renamed description carries a law exactly where the description does. (`Becoming.SharedCodes.hearBy_keeps_renaming`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_renamed`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.reached_differ_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_renamed_tells_apart_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.renamed_goAlike_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.renamed_carries_iff`)
7. Agreement needs a broken symmetry: a law keeping an exchange of formations and a renaming of forms keeps a symmetric start symmetric, so formations it exchanges never agree where the renaming moves every form; a centre, a preferred form and an order of hearing each break one symmetry and bring agreement. (`Becoming.Law.KeepsRelation.run`, `Becoming.Law.Commutes.keepsRelation`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.keeps_both`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.agrees_only_fixed`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.never_agrees`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.never_agrees_of_both`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.pair_agrees_only_fixed`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.pair_never_agrees`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.TwoFormations.crossing_never_agrees`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.TwoFormations.three_agree`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.TwoFormations.centre_breaks_exchange`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.TwoFormations.preferred_breaks_renaming`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.TwoFormations.ordered_breaks_exchange`)
8. An imposed code makes all agree and read each other where it tells senses apart; each formation loses what its code told apart and the imposed code merges, its source nothing; along every later run of hearing this stays, and a merged distinction comes back only from a form kept outside. (`Becoming.SharedCodes.impose_agrees`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.self_reads_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.impose_loses_iff`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.source_loses_nothing`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.held_stays`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_imposed_stays`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.run_from_imposition`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.outside_needed`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.outside_returns`)
9. A resolution written back into the records later generations read rests from the next generation on, merges the histories resolving alike, so no later reading recovers them, and under omission rests away from the target; kept records bar a different resolution, and where records are only added a resolution is lost but never replaced. (`Becoming.SharedCodes.resolve`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.nextCohort`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.WritesExactly`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.written_rests`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.every_cohort_resolves`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.resolved_alike_merged`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.nextCohort_merges`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.no_reading_recovers`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.covered_rest`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.omitted_rest`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.kept_bars`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.kept_rests`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.adding`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.added_never_replaced`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.Gloss.taken_up_locks`, `Becoming.SharedCodes.Gloss.uptake_loses`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. The codes, the hearings and the rule of adoption are given; every other premise is named where it is used: hearings closed for a group; hearings that take the form heard; two forms that differ; a list of every formation; a rule reading codes alike after a renaming; a law keeping an exchange and a renaming; a renaming moving every form at the sense; records written to offer exactly what was resolved; decided equality of formations and senses where an order is stepped back through.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- Which orders actual exchange takes, with probabilities over orders, and how long agreement takes: the voter model's and the naming game's expectations are not stated.
- Codes holding several forms for a sense, rules reading more than the two codes, adoption of whole codes, and an exact step bound for a pointer law on finite sets.
- That actual conventions, scripts or the theory's own terms form by hearing in this way, or whether a shared, imposed or kept code supports or damages 生生.
- **Counterexample:** The proposed coupling form refuted (Path.never_agree): on the path a – c – b, every two formations joined through couplings and each adopting at once the code of the least-indexed of itself and its couplings, a and b each point to themselves and never agree, so agreement under that law is not equivalent to every coupling closure being the whole. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SharedCodes.lean)
- **Counterexample:** A symmetric law never agrees (TwoFormations.crossing_never_agrees): two formations each taking the other's form at once exchange their forms forever. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SharedCodes.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Agreement can cost distinctions (TwoFormations.homonym): two codes each telling two senses apart, one hearing the other at one sense, leave the hearer one form for both. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/SharedCodes.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

RO's chapter on the Chinese sources found the spine lacking a law of a code formed between formations (荀子 正名: 名无固宜，约定俗成谓之宜; 同则同之，异则异之), of an imposed code (說文叙: 书同文) and of a reading written back (說文: 止戈为武). Hearing by adoption is the voter model and the naming game, the codes those of Lewis signalling systems, the symmetry law equivariance (Curie's principle). The readings onto the texts are the AI's (D56).

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [what-a-commuting-law-keeps-apart](what-a-commuting-law-keeps-apart.md). Uses Law.Commutes and its run laws: Law.Commutes.keepsRelation is the relational form of keeps_fixed, and pair_agrees_only_fixed reads it on two formations.
  - Output: A law commuting with a map keeps the relation of a configuration to its image along its runs.
  - Input: From a pair the joint exchange fixes, the two formations agree only on a form the renaming fixes.
  - Preserved conditions: The law commutes with exchanging the two formations together with the forms. [Commuting.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Commuting.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [projection-carrying-a-law](projection-carrying-a-law.md). Uses carries_law_iff: renamed_carries_iff states that a renamed description carries a law exactly where the description does.
  - Output: A projection carries a determined law exactly where configurations alike under it go alike.
  - Input: Renaming forms by a map telling them apart keeps which descriptions carry a law.
  - Preserved conditions: The renaming tells forms apart. [Mechanism.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Mechanism.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [recurrence-without-premise](recurrence-without-premise.md). Uses Law.orbit, Law.run, Law.Merges and Law.merged_stays for the pointer law and the generations of records.
  - Output: What a law merges stays merged along its runs.
  - Input: Two histories of records resolving alike are one from the next generation on, and no later reading recovers them.
  - Preserved conditions: Each generation writes a record offering exactly what it resolved. [Recurrence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Recurrence.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [chinese-sources-on-the-spine](chinese-sources-on-the-spine.md). Closes the second of its seven gaps (a code formed between formations); four passages of its map are re-pointed to these laws.
- related, not a proved adapter: [what-finitely-many-labels-fix](what-finitely-many-labels-fix.md). A code read off finitely many labels of a given feature: supplied to one side, where here the code forms between formations.
- related, not a proved adapter: [historical-source-binding](historical-source-binding.md). Dated controls separate rival histories; here records kept from before are what bar a reading written back (kept_bars).
